refined_conclusion: 0xE60B78 is not a per-object field -- it is a widely used GLOBAL KEY (261 references). The xor at 0x66F206 decodes a function pointer: real_target = [cl+0x2C] ^ [cl+0x30] ^ KEY. With cl zeroed the two cl terms vanish and edx becomes the KEY ITSELF, so the code calls the key as if it were a function address and faults there.
